champion.tips: CORKI TIPS AND TRICKS Delay a team fight for as long as possible while you poke the enemy down. If you get the enemy low before initiating the fight, your chancces of winning it will be increased. Do not use your W aggressively if the enemy has a CC ability up. Wait for it to be on cooldown before initiating and playing aggressively. When using your Q and R on the minion wave to push, try to use both of them so they’ll hit the enemy champion and push the wave at the same time. This is a great use of your mana pool.
champion.builds: THE BEST CORKI BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR BOT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Corki Bot build, you should take Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Conqueror as your keystone, followed by Presence of Mind, Legend: Alacrity and Cut Down in the primary tree, as well as Biscuit Delivery and Jack Of All Trades in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Trinity Force as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Manamune. For your last 3 items, you should build The Collector, Infinity Edge and finish with Rapid Firecannon. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 50.1% winrate over 15 810 matches played. Optional Your second option for Corki Bot build would be to take Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Fleet Footwork as your keystone, Absorb Life, Legend: Alacrity and Cut Down in the primary tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense. The items for the build are Trinity Force, which you should build first, followed by Plated Steelcaps as your second item and Manamune as your third item. The rest of the items in order are The Collector, Infinity Edge and Rapid Firecannon. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 46.7% win rate over 871 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Conqueror as your keystone, Presence of Mind, Legend: Alacrity and Cut Down in the primary tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Jack Of All Trades in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Manamune as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Trinity Force as a third item. You want to finish the build with The Collector, Infinity Edge and Mortal Reminder. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 46.5% win rate across 202 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Corki Bot build in the current patch, try Flash and Barrier as your Summoner Spells, Hail of Blades, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter as your primary rune tree, and Coup de Grace with Presence of Mind as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Adaptive Force and Health as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Trinity Force as your first item, then finish Plated Steelcaps as your second item, and Manamune as third item. The last 3 options are The Collector, Infinity Edge and Lord Dominik's Regards. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 45.9% win rate over 181 matches played. Situational Corki Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Corki build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Corki runes page.
